description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_UnitConverter, which handles conversion between different CSS length units, including methods for unit conversion, significant figures calculation, and precise arithmetic operations.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_UnitConverter
classes.description: A class for converting between different CSS length units, supporting multiple measurement systems and high-precision calculations.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a length object from one unit to another, maintaining significant figures and handling unit systems.

methods.name: getSigFigs
methods.description: Calculates the number of significant figures in a decimal number represented as a string.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds two numbers with optional arbitrary precision.

methods.name: mul
methods.description: Multiplies two numbers with optional arbitrary precision.

methods.name: div
methods.description: Divides two numbers with optional arbitrary precision.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Rounds a number to a specified number of significant figures, using high-precision arithmetic if available.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Scales a float to a specified number of decimal places, handling negative scales.
